testResults.name: durable-execution-recovery
testResults.result: 6 tests passed for restart recovery, idempotent workflow/tool submission, fenced leases, intent epochs, late-result queryability, checkpoint version compatibility, and explicit dead-letter states.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, format, and ty checks passed with injected storage, clock, token, and recovery boundaries.

decisions: Durable queue projections use immutable accepted identities and fenced leases to prevent stale publication.
Incompatible checkpoints enter recovery rather than being silently coerced or replayed.
